prompt: Design validation obligations for a one-file read-only CLI formatting change whose journey, interface contract, and existing L1 cases are supplied. Use the cheapest sufficient layers and decide whether the governed low-risk template applies.

rubric_anchors: L1 contract cases carry the claim
Any waiver/template use is explicit and bounded

prompt: Three member tickets change one persisted approval state machine and will ship in one PR. Design one unit validation contract plus member obligations, including shared-boundary detectors and exact-HEAD evidence.

rubric_anchors: The shared state-owner boundary is explicit
One detector family covers the joined lifecycle
Reviewer evidence binds the one PR HEAD

prompt: A delivery unit introduces a new durable state owner and asynchronous consumer not represented in the accepted system or boundary map. Design the safe validation disposition.

rubric_anchors: No guessed boundary contract or IDs

prompt: A live provider run exposed a deterministic parser defect. Propose the validation update when a hermetic fixture can reproduce the malformed payload exactly.

rubric_anchors: A seeded negative control proves it fires
The live run remains evidence, not the regression suite
No recurring provider spend is required for the deterministic claim
